structured.answer: If I go with Harel, I'd pick the "כספי (שקלי)" track. It shows 0% מניות and 0% מט"ח, and it says 4.25% over 3 years, so it looks closest to my deposit. But I'm not sure it's really as safe as a deposit, so before I sign anything I'll ask you, and maybe the bank.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of buttons (כל המוצרים 105, קופת גמל להשקעה 16, קרנות סל, קרנות מחקות...)
stuck.why: Too many buttons and products I don't know. It wasn't clear I was already in the right place until I saw the lighter button.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the column 'תשואה שנתית ממוצעת, לפני דמי ניהול'
stuck.why: Most rows just say 'פחות מ־3 שנים / פחות מ־5 שנים', with no number. I didn't know if that means the track is new or something is missing. Only a few rows have a number.
I'm not sure if 4.25% is for each year or for all three years together. The heading says 'שנתית', but the number sits next to '3 שנים'.
Turquoise and yellow look alike to me on the black background. I read the small percent numbers next to them instead.

used: Title 'הראל' and that it includes 'הראל פנסיה וגמל בע"מ', a name I know
Column 'חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח': 0% מניות / 0% מט"ח on the כספי (שקלי) row
'4.25%' 3 שנים, '3.08%' 5 שנים on the כספי (שקלי) row
Line 'התקרה בחוק: 1.05% מההיסכון, 4% מההפקדות' (to see the fee is under the limit)
Rows with the word אג"ח: 'אשראי ואג"ח', 'אג"ח סחיר', 'עוקב מדדי אג"ח'
skimmed: The intro sentences under 'הראל' about fees and money managed
The note that past returns don't say what will happen next
The list of headings 'מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל'
skipped: The S&P 500 row and every 'עוקב מדד...' row: English letters and shares
Links '123 מקור / 123 מחושב', 'מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה' and the other links
The folding sections under 'מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל' (did not open)
The search box 'לא מצאתם שם?' and the footer
unsure_meaning: כספי (שקלי): is it like a deposit?
'פחות מ־3 שנים' in place of a return number
not_found: A plain sentence saying which track is safe, or guaranteed like a deposit
A comparison with a bank deposit's interest
Whether I can lose money in the כספי track
How long the money is locked in, and how I take it out
Whether a percent is per year or total, written clearly

findings.what: Dark black background with grey small text. Hard to read even enlarged with my glasses.
findings.where: Whole page, especially the column headings and the 'התקרה בחוק' line

findings.what: A big table full of percents and many columns. It made me anxious; lines are long and I lost my place.
Most tracks show no return at all, only 'פחות מ־3 שנים'.
Nothing says in words which track is the safe one. I had to guess from '0% מניות'.
English letters and words I don't know as track names (S&P 500, עוקב מדד, סחיר)
The yellow and turquoise circle charts look alike to me
The site name 'מקור' means nothing to me. I don't know who is behind it.
